The current approach to information security in the cloud is not effective and does not provide the required level of protection for information.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following: 1) What are the current approaches for securing information in the cloud?
the question of how we can improve the security of information systems, and in particular, the cloud.
the development of a new business architecture for the protection of information.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
cloud information security is not a problem of technology, but rather one of people and process.
cloud computing has not changed the fundamentals of information security.
there is no single solution that can be applied to the security of information in a cloud environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new model of information security that is more effective and efficient than existing models, and which can be used to guide the development of information security solutions.
the business model of the company needs to be the focus of information security research, and the business architecture needs to be the basis of the security solution.
the cloud is not a new technology and the same security approaches that we have used in the past will work in the cloud.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we need to move beyond technology, and consider a more holistic approach.
we should not be using the same approach to cloud information security as we use to non-cloud information security.
the business architecture is the key factor to be addressed when considering information security.
